messages:
Mia Chen: brainstorming final run-of-show for May 10 webinar. primary goal: convert trials to Dedicated evals and surface Private leads. working title: "From Benchmarks to Reliable SLOs". quick takes?

Liz Torres: title good. i'll do product + Optimize best practices (12m). want 1 slide with cost/latency tradeoffs and 1 clear CTA to claim trial creds.

Arjun Patel: i'll cover routing, KV cache, and a short failover demo (8m). plan for a 90s live snippet + pre-recorded fallback.

Samir Gupta: CS will provide a migration vignette (6m). need privacy approval for quote/logo.

marketing-bot: note: slides due 2024-05-01. suggested promo dates posted to the calendar. landing draft: https://airtable.com/shrExample

Nathan Lee: customer prefers pre-recorded clip for the demo. can deliver clip by 2024-05-03 and join live for Q&A.

Mia Chen: draft run-of-show (50m):
- 00:00-03:00 welcome & goals (Mia)
- 03:00-15:00 product + Optimize (Liz)
- 15:00-25:00 infra & demo (Arjun)
- 25:00-33:00 customer vignette (Samir + Nathan)
- 33:00-47:00 live Q&A (panel)
- 47:00-50:00 CTAs & close (Liz + Mia)
notes: record to S3, enable captions, two demo fallbacks (pre-record + canned API replay). rehearsal windows: 2024-05-08 10:00 PT or 2024-05-09 15:00 PT. which works?

Arjun Patel: 5/8 10:00 PT good. i'll post 99p/median numbers for small/med/large and a short demo script by EOD. fallback snippet will be in the runbook.

Liz Torres: please include token-cost per 1k tokens on the benchmark slide. also want a one-line SLO recommendation (p95/p99 thresholds).

ops-bot: stream key reserved; captions enabled. rehearsal instance booked for 2024-05-08 09:30-11:00 PT.

Mia Chen: action items recap: Liz = final deck + CTAs by 2024-05-01; Arjun = benchmarks CSV + chart + demo script by EOD; Nathan = customer clip by 2024-05-03; Samir = privacy sign-off by 2024-04-30; Ops = confirm stream + captions (done).

Samir Gupta: i'll chase privacy approvals and update thread by 2024-04-30.

Mia Chen: perfect. i'll send invites + runbook link after deadlines. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
